Home.subtitle: Pick the voting method that fits your decision, launch it and share in two clicks. The winner is computed by its exact rules — not just another poll.
Home.methodsTitleLearn: There's more than one way to pick a winner
Home.slackText: Launch a vote without leaving your channels — /scrutin, everyone votes on the web, the result comes back to the channel.

steps.s1Text: « Where should we go this weekend? » Add your options, like a poll among friends.
steps.s2Text: Suffrage, rounds, tally, randomness… with pros and cons shown live.
steps.s3Text: Everyone votes, the winner is computed by the real method — and we explain why.

Create.questionPlaceholder: E.g. Where should we go this weekend?
Create.descriptionPlaceholder: Context (optional) — e.g. Marie's birthday, €25/person budget, ideally downtown
Create.imageNotFound: ⚠️ Image not found — check the link.
Create.aiHintAttach: 🔗 attach an image, a video or a document to a choice.
Create.aiHintHighlight: ✨ An AI can suggest titles, options and illustrations
Create.methodSubtitle: How are votes settled? Changeable at any time.
Create.axisSuffrageHint: Does everyone vote directly, or through electors?
Create.axisCountingHint: How are ballots turned into a result?
Create.axisRoundsHint: A single pass, or qualify first then settle again in a (any-type) second round?
Create.axisQualifHint: Who gets to make it past the first round?
Create.axisRandomHint: Draw lots when duels form a cycle (Condorcet paradox)?
Create.axisLocalCountingHint: How each district picks its champion — that vote can be any type.
Create.axisElectorSplitHint: Does the local winner take all, or are electors split proportionally to votes?
Create.axisRandomLocalHint: Draw lots if a district hits a Condorcet deadlock.

Vote.instructionGrade: Give a grade to each option.

Access.title: Access & electorate
Access.verifiedHint: Verified result — voter list, 1 vote per person (named links).
Access.quickHint: Indicative result — link open to everyone; multiple votes possible.
Access.geWarning: For real electoral-college voters, choose "Verified vote": otherwise districts are assigned at random.
Access.closeOnComplete: Close as soon as everyone has voted
Access.votersHint: One name per line. Each person gets a unique link (1 vote per person).
Access.districtsHint: Each district has a number of electors and its own voter list (one name per line).

Timing.title: Duration & validity
Timing.opensHint: No ballot is accepted before this date. Empty = open immediately.
Timing.quorumHint: Minimum number of ballots for the result to be considered valid.

AiHelper.subtitle: Pick an assistant: it receives the prompt and sends you back a Placet link ready to confirm here.
AiHelper.pasteHint: The prompt is copied automatically — on Gemini, Copilot, Grok or Le Chat, just paste it (Ctrl/⌘+V).
